description: Source code for wpa_supplicant ucode integration, handling interface management, BSS info, and DPP/WPS events.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_iface_get_uval
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a ucode resource for a wpa_supplicant interface.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_update_interfaces
methods.description: Updates the list of interfaces in the ucode environment.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_bss_get_uval
methods.description: Creates a ucode object representing a BSS.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_add_bss
methods.description: Adds a BSS to the ucode environment.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_free_bss
methods.description: Removes a BSS from the ucode environment.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_bss_allowed
methods.description: Checks if a BSS is allowed via ucode callback.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_update_state
methods.description: Updates the interface state in ucode.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_event
methods.description: Handles a wpa_supplicant event and reports it via ucode.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_ctrl_event
methods.description: Sends a control event to ucode.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_wps_complete
methods.description: Reports WPS credential completion to ucode.

methods.name: uc_wpas_iface_wps_set_m7
methods.description: Sets M7 message for WPS via ucode.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_wps_m8_rx
methods.description: Handles received WPS M8 message.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_dpp_rx_action
methods.description: Handles received DPP action frame.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_dpp_gas_rx
methods.description: Handles received DPP GAS frame.

methods.name: uc_wpas_iface_dpp_send_action
methods.description: Sends DPP action frame.

methods.name: uc_wpas_iface_dpp_send_gas_req
methods.description: Sends DPP GAS request.

methods.name: obj_stringval
methods.description: Helper to get string value from ucode object.

methods.name: uc_wpas_add_iface
methods.description: Adds a new interface via ucode.

methods.name: uc_wpas_remove_iface
methods.description: Removes an interface via ucode.

methods.name: uc_wpas_iface_status
methods.description: Gets status of an interface.
